controls.detail: Published shape · grid marks missing imagery
controls.description: Convex light-curve shape with thermophysical volume-equivalent diameter 45.4 ± 1.3 km. The published fit uses the same pole family; an alternative pole remains possible. The grid marks unavailable imagery and rotational phase is illustrative.

controls.description: Radius on the shape model minus a 22.7 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
